description: Lip-sync: redraws the mouth of the person in a rendered segment to match the narration. ByteDance LatentSync 1.6 via the ComfyUI-LatentSyncWrapper custom node (github.com/ShmuelRonen/ComfyUI-LatentSyncWrapper, node LatentSyncNode: images, audio, seed, lips_expression, inference_steps -> images, audio). The node treats its frames as 25 fps, so the segment is converted to 25 fps before upload and back to the segment's own rate after. Core nodes: LoadVideo, GetVideoComponents, LoadAudio, CreateVideo, SaveVideo. Not yet run on the real GPU system: verify with `manage.py lipsync_setup --check` there.
